description: the pr0036 structural gate: a bordered Goethals-Seidel instance on the non-cyclic group Z2 x Z3 x Z3 whose seeds are constant on the orbits of a NON-SCALAR multiplier subgroup M <= Aut(G)

multiplier.note: M <= Aut(G) is the MULTIPLIER group the seeds are invariant under.  It is NOT the Theorem-A Gram matrix M of H1; see NOTES.md.  An automorphism is banked as a matrix A with alpha(t)_a = sum_b A[a][b]*t[b] mod factors[a].
